'''Al'cair'rahienallen''', meaning "Hill of the Golden Dawn" in the [[Old Tongue]],{{ref/book|1|36}} was the capital city of [[Almoren]], which was part of the [[Ten Nations]].

During their reconstruction after the [[Breaking of the World]], [[Ogier]] built a [[Ways|waygate]] to Al'cair'rahienallen.{{ref/book|6|20}} It later became the city of [[Cairhien]].
